reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur,
  spend_eur - LAG(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date) AS change_eur
FROM daily

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), paired AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT d.channel_id, d.spend_date, d.spend_eur,
    (SELECT MAX(d2.spend_date) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.channel_id = d.channel_id AND d2.spend_date < d.spend_date) AS prev_date
  FROM daily d
)
SELECT p.channel_id, p.spend_date, p.spend_eur, p.spend_eur - b.spend_eur AS change_eur
FROM paired p
LEFT JOIN daily b ON b.channel_id = p.channel_id AND b.spend_date = p.prev_date

  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), paired AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT d.channel_id, d.spend_date, d.spend_eur,
    (SELECT MAX(d2.spend_date) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.channel_id = d.channel_id AND d2.spend_date < d.spend_date) AS prev_date
  FROM daily d
)
SELECT p.channel_id, p.spend_date, p.spend_eur, p.spend_eur - b.spend_eur AS change_eur
FROM paired p
LEFT JOIN daily b ON b.channel_id = p.channel_id AND b.spend_date = p.prev_date
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each day to the channel's latest earlier day works without a window, but takes another step and a two-column join.
